# Results: MLE vs Bayesian parameter estimation

*Auto-generated by `main.py`. All data are simulated, so the true parameters are known.*

## 1. Parameter estimation (`01_parameter_estimation_mse.png`, `02_posterior_evolution.png`)

| n = 5 | MSE of MLE | MSE of Bayesian posterior mean |
|---|---|---|
| Bernoulli p | 0.0437 | 0.0214 |
| Gaussian mean | 0.7842 | 0.5063 |

95 % interval coverage for the Gaussian mean at n = 5: MLE (frequentist CI) 0.950,
Bayesian credible interval 0.966.
At n = 200 the two estimators' MSEs are 0.0199 vs 0.0196: the prior has washed out.

## 4. Calibration at n = 5 per class (`06_calibration_small_n.png`)

| | accuracy | mean confidence | share of predictions with confidence > 0.99 |
|---|---|---|---|
| MLE | 0.725 | 0.898 | 0.473 |
| Bayes | 0.764 | 0.846 | 0.164 |

A calibrated model's mean confidence matches its accuracy. If confidence is well above accuracy, the model is **over-confident**.

## 5. Prior sensitivity (`07_prior_sensitivity.png`)

Test accuracy, varying prior strength κ₀ (≈ the number of pseudo-observations behind the prior mean):

| prior | model | n=3 | n=10 | n=50 | n=300 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| correct prior: μ₀ₖ = true class means | MLE | 0.649 | 0.776 | 0.815 | 0.820 |
| correct prior: μ₀ₖ = true class means | kappa0=0.01 | 0.748 | 0.789 | 0.815 | 0.820 |
| correct prior: μ₀ₖ = true class means | kappa0=1 | 0.773 | 0.792 | 0.816 | 0.820 |
| correct prior: μ₀ₖ = true class means | kappa0=10 | 0.796 | 0.805 | 0.816 | 0.820 |
| correct prior: μ₀ₖ = true class means | kappa0=50 | 0.795 | 0.809 | 0.817 | 0.820 |
| wrong prior: μ₀ₖ = the OTHER class's mean | MLE | 0.640 | 0.781 | 0.815 | 0.819 |
| wrong prior: μ₀ₖ = the OTHER class's mean | kappa0=0.01 | 0.745 | 0.794 | 0.816 | 0.819 |
| wrong prior: μ₀ₖ = the OTHER class's mean | kappa0=1 | 0.659 | 0.783 | 0.815 | 0.820 |
| wrong prior: μ₀ₖ = the OTHER class's mean | kappa0=10 | 0.347 | 0.561 | 0.804 | 0.819 |
| wrong prior: μ₀ₖ = the OTHER class's mean | kappa0=50 | 0.312 | 0.373 | 0.625 | 0.813 |
